note: Mutants of the alerts, invitations and mentions of the chat hub (hub/people.py, hub/presence.py `inv`, hub/commands.py `/invite`, hub/chat.py, hub/limits.py, hub/store/; docs/HUB_PEOPLE.md) for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'): each breaks one rule on purpose (an invitation to oneself, to somebody who plays, to a full room, to the room that the person is in; the limits of one a minute per person and five a minute in all, per account and not per socket; a person who ignores the inviter who is invited or who tells; a banned account or a person who is not here who is invited; two people with one name told apart by luck; a room's code that stays after the room has gone, an invitation that never ends, that ends at once, that ends not for a full room or for another room; a hub that starts again that keeps invitations open; a name that is marked inside a word, past its end, for two people, shortest first, in one case only, in code points and not in the page's units, more than ten; the writer, more than three people, the same pair twice, more than ten an hour, a banned person, a person who ignores the writer who are alerted; a line that is deleted that keeps its marks or its alerts; an account that forgets itself that keeps its invitations or the alerts that are from it; a list that is cut at the wrong number or the wrong days or is somebody else's, a seen that reads too much or somebody else's, a clear that clears everybody's; a room that is not checked; the invitation as a command of a rank; the marks of a line), and a test of tests/scripts/test_hub_people.py or of the store's contract must notice.
